page_title: NAN 1-2 CLE | Nantes v Clermont 14/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+1' Clermont failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' 1 - 2 Jim Allevinah (Clermont) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
88' It will be a corner kick for Clermont.
87' Jocelyn Gourvennec decides to make a substitution. Eray Comert will be replaced by Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes).
84' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Nantes.
84' Kader Bamba (Nantes) unleashes a decent strike heading to the bottom right corner, but the keeper dives like Superman and keeps it out.
81' Clermont have a corner.
78' The resulting set piece from Clermont is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
77' The linesman makes the right call and Nantes will have a corner.
75' Jocelyn Gourvennec has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Fabien Centonze (Nantes) replacing Marcus Coco.
73' It‘s a RED card, and quite right too after seeing the replay! Referee Romain Lissorgue had no choice but to send Benie Traore (Nantes) off. VAR seen to good effect there!

73' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Benie Traore (Nantes), but referee Romain Lissorgue must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
73' Alan Virginius comes off the pitch to be replaced by Elbasan Rashani (Clermont).
72' Pascal Gastien has decided to make a change. Muhammed Cham (Clermont) replaces Bilal Boutobba.
72' Here comes a substitution. Maxime Gonalons is given a rest as he is replaced by Yohan Magnin (Clermont).
71' A player from Nantes commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
70' Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
64' Johan Gastien goes off the pitch and Habib Keita (Clermont) comes on.
63' Florent Mollet (Nantes) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
58' Nantes are ruled offside.
57' Nantes win a corner.

57' He should have scored! Benie Traore (Nantes) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom left corner is pretty weak and Massamba N'Diaye makes an easy save.
55' Kader Bamba (Nantes) sends a cross into the box, but Massamba N'Diaye comes off his line to gather the ball.
55' Kader Bamba (Nantes) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Massamba N'Diaye intercepts the ball.
54' Johan Gastien (Clermont) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
53' Florent Mollet (Nantes) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
52' Nantes take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
51' Substitution. Cheick Oumar Konate walks off the pitch and Yoel Armougom (Clermont) comes on as a substitute.
47' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Benie Traore tees up Florent Mollet (Nantes) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Massamba N'Diaye.
46' Jocelyn Gourvennec has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Kader Bamba (Nantes) comes on the pitch for Pedro Chirivella.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nantes.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.

44' A neat pass finds Moussa Sissoko (Nantes) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the bottom right corner, but Massamba N'Diaye denies him with a good save.
42' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Nantes, play can continue.
41' Referee Romain Lissorgue makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Nantes. Let’s see what happens!
40' Surely that's handball by one of the Clermont players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
39' Nantes can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
38' Florent Mollet (Nantes) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
33' Nantes have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
32' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) makes a good run inside the box to meet a precise cross. He latches on to it and shoots, but the goalkeeper pulls off an excellent save.
29' 0 - 1 Goal! Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.

28' Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) latched on to an accurate pass just outside the box and immediately lashed the ball towards the top left corner. His effort was thwarted by Alban Lafont, who pulled off a stunning save.
27' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nantes comes to nothing.
23' The corner is swung in but Nantes can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

23' Florent Mollet (Nantes) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the bottom right corner. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper dives to make a stunning save.
20' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Nantes.
20' Tino Kadewere (Nantes) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Massamba N'Diaye is alert and denies him.
17' Clermont are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
13' Clermont have been awarded a corner kick.
11' Neto Borges (Clermont) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post.
5' Great teamplay by Nantes as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' Florent Mollet (Nantes) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Nantes will kick-off.
Romain Lissorgue got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
